text:
mara: Heads up — ran into a weird JSON mode quirk in the Python SDK when calling tools that expect optional fields. Sample app `data-exporter` started failing schema validation after we upgraded the SDK.

jen: hmm, what quirk? any repro?

mara: repro is small. using the helper `call_tool` with an optional numeric field that we omit. On first try it sends no key (as expected). If the SDK triggers an auth retry path the payload arrives with `field: null` instead of being omitted. Server schema is strict about `field` being optional (not nullable) so validation fails.

oscar: can you paste the minimal snippet?

mara:
```py
# py sdk v1.3.2
res = client.call_tool("export", {"format": "csv"})  # no 'limit' key
# simulate auth token refresh -> retry
# server receives: {"format":"csv","limit":null}
```

paul: that sounds like our helper coercing missing keys to None during the refresh flow. interestingly, JSON mode serializes python None to null, so if we reconstructed kwargs from a stored tuple/dict that used `.get(k)` defaulting to None it would do that.

jen: do we store arguments in the auth-refresh queue? i thought we kept the original dict.

mara: looks like the auth wrapper does partial shallow-copy then merges defaults for retry to support backward compat with old send semantics. the merge sets absent keys to None in some codepath.

ci-bot: samples/data-exporter e2e failed 	7% tests (toolcall-optional-null.test.py)

oscar: assigning this to @sdk-team. regression test will be valuable.

paul: quick fix idea: when building retry payload, don't materialize missing keys; preserve the original mapping shape. only apply defaults at the final send-time if the contract requires them. also add a serializer helper that treats 'UNSET' sentinel differently from None so we can tell original-absent vs explicit-null.

mara: I prototyped a sentinel approach (`class _Unset: pass`) and it worked locally — retries preserved absence. will open PR.

jen: add unit tests: python sdk, jsonmode, optional/nullable matrix: (absent, None, value) and an integration e2e where we flip auth to force refresh mid-request. CI should catch this for sample apps.

oscar: also check streaming mode where chunks are reassembled; ensure we don't coerce fields while reconstructing metadata objects.

paul: note for changelog: "fix(python-sdk): preserve absent optional fields on auth/retry in json-mode toolcalls"

mara: PR #4120 draft up. included tests and a small sentinel impl. left a note about performance — sentinel check is O(1) and negligible.

ci-bot: linked issue #6798 created: "py-sdk: auth retry injects null for absent optional toolcall fields"

jen: can we also add a lint rule in samples to catch asserts that relied on null semantics? i found one assertion in data-exporter expecting `limit is None` that now needs update.

oscar: good call. we'll update sample and add a migration note in release docs.

mara: thanks folks. leaving the sample e2e running on canary infra and will post status. :thumbsup:

sdk-team: ack, we'll review the PR and schedule backport to the 1.3.x branch if approved.

mara: can repro script attached in PR comments; ping me if you need netem script to flip token endpoint.
